description: This file implements a bandwidth-delay product (BDP) estimator used for flow control in gRPC transport layer, including functions for measuring RTT, bandwidth, and adjusting flow control windows.

classes.name: bdpEstimator
classes.description: A struct for estimating the bandwidth-delay product (BDP) and managing flow control adjustments based on network conditions.

methods.name: timesnap
methods.description: Records the time when a BDP ping was sent to calculate RTT upon acknowledgment.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds bytes to the current sample for BDP calculation; determines if a ping should be sent.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates current BDP and bandwidth based on acknowledgment data; updates flow control if necessary.
